The GitHub App updater uses the API endpoint, but its current module-output dependency does not ensure the API Gateway stage has been provisioned. The updater should wait for the stage before configuring the webhook.

The GitHub App updater can run before the API Gateway route is configured; the referenced endpoint output only implies dependencies on selected API/Lambda outputs. Ensure the route (and its integration) exists before configuring the webhook.
